channel.title: Web3 Security Paper Digest
channel.description: Curated papers on Web3, blockchain, and smart contract security from ArXiv and ACL

item.title: Benchmarking Zero-Shot Reasoning Approaches for Error Detection in Solidity Smart Contracts
item.description:
Summary

  • Benchmarks zero-shot LLM prompting strategies for detecting and classifying Solidity smart contract vulnerabilities using a dataset of 400 contracts.
  • Evaluates binary vulnerability detection and multi-class vulnerability categorization across prompt types (zero-shot, CoT, ToT) and multiple LLMs.
  • Finds that CoT/ToT improves recall substantially but often lowers precision in vulnerability detection, affecting false-positive rates.

Paper Type

  • Benchmarking

Additional Information

  • Authors: ['Eduardo Sardenberg', "Antonio Jos\\'e Grandson Busson", 'Daniel de Sousa Moraes', 'Julio Cesar Duarte', "S\\'ergio Colcher"]
  • Tags: ['Smart Contract Security', 'Solidity Vulnerability Detection', 'LLM Prompting (Zero-shot/CoT/ToT)', 'DeFi/Web3 Security Tools']

item.title: Emergent Formal Verification: How an Autonomous AI Ecosystem Independently Discovered SMT-Based Safety Across Six Domains
item.description:
Summary

  • The paper centers on applying SMT-based formal verification (Z3) to verify safety properties across multiple domains, explicitly including “smart contract safety.”
  • It proposes a unified framework (substrate-guard) that applies Z3-based verification across output classes, evaluated with test cases and bug detection.
  • Reported detected issues include an INT_MIN overflow and formal un-verifiability results; smart contract safety is treated as one of the six verification domains.

Paper Type

  • Research

Additional Information

  • Authors: ['Octavian Untila']
  • Tags: ['smart-contract security', 'formal verification', 'SMT/Z3', 'AI safety', 'automated vulnerability detection']
